lcc_original: 於是地生出了青草，和結種子的菜蔬，各從其類，跟結果子的樹，各從其類，果子裏有種子。上帝看這很好。
notes: UNV 神 → LCC 上帝 (standard variant for Elohim)
UNV 發生了 → LCC 生出了 (synonymous verb, same H3318)
UNV 樹木 → LCC 樹 (abbreviated form, same H6086)
UNV {<WAH09002>} implicit 'in it' → LCC 裏 explicitly means 'inside', braces dropped per Rule 3
UNV {<WAH03588>} implicit 'that/כִּי' → LCC 這 serves as complementizer introducing the clause, braces dropped per Rule 3
UNV {<WAH0834>} 'which/אֲשֶׁר' kept implicit — LCC has no explicit relative pronoun; the relationship is expressed structurally via 裏
LCC 有 (have) has no Hebrew equivalent (Hebrew uses nominal clause אֲשֶׁר זַרְעוֹ־בוֹ), left unannotated per Rule 5
LCC 很 (very) is a Chinese intensifier with no separate Hebrew source, grouped with 好 for H2896
